mainEntity.name: What is included in Cashflow Management London support?

acceptedAnswer.text: It usually includes cash flow forecasting, review of expected receipts and outgoings, scenario planning, and regular discussion of the decisions that affect liquidity.

mainEntity.name: Is this service only for businesses in cash trouble?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is also useful for businesses that are growing, hiring, investing, or dealing with uneven payment timing and want better forward visibility before problems appear.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between profit and cash flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Profit shows whether revenue exceeds costs over a period. Cash flow shows when money actually comes in and out. A profitable business can still face cash pressure if timing is weak.

mainEntity.name: How often should a cash forecast be reviewed?

acceptedAnswer.text: That depends on the business, but many growing businesses benefit from a weekly or monthly review cadence so assumptions stay current and pressure points are visible early.

mainEntity.name: Can this work with our current finance support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Financeable Consulting can work alongside an existing accountant, finance manager, or bookkeeper to strengthen forecasting, visibility, and cash-related decision support.

mainEntity.name: Why is cash forecasting important during growth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Growth often increases payroll, supplier commitments, and working capital strain before cash receipts catch up. Forecasting helps management see whether current growth is financially sustainable.
